items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Finally, after all of this going on, Nick tells me one night, he say, Zutty, he say, the old man say he can't get along with you.

ctx.x: The spirituals. And wanted Zutty to go to the union with him and to put a knock in against them that they weren't acting right. They were getting drunk and all, get them out. And Zutty said I'm not going to tear up the group.

Finally, after all of this going on, Nick tells me one night, he say, Zutty, he say, the old man say he can't get along with you. And old Bechet and I hadn't had any trouble or anything like that. But he just wanted me out after me getting him in there.
